text:
Carewell | Machine Learning Engineer | Amsterdam, Netherlands | ONSITE (hybrid) | €6,000 - €7,000 per month | Full-time (80–100%) | Visa sponsorship possible

Company: Carewell builds speech tools that let care professionals write up their notes by talking, so they spend less time on screens and more with clients.

Role: As an ML Engineer you will take models from prototype to production: training, serving, monitoring and continuous improvement in the cloud. Teams are small and close.

Suitability: hands-on responsibility in an ML role. Full-stack with some ML exposure is not a fit for this position.

Apply: https://carewell.recruitee.com/o/machine-learning-engineer
